content.title: Why Dynatrace (DT) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of cloud observability platform Dynatrace (NYSE:DT) jumped 3.4% in the afternoon session after Guggenheim reiterated its Buy rating, predicting the company would exceed all its fiscal third-quarter top and bottom-line metrics. The research firm expected Dynatrace's subscription revenue to remain stable at around 17%, ahead of the company's own guidance of 13.5%. Guggenheim also forecasted significant growth in net new annual recurring revenue.
